first_hour_colony_lines: Tap ground to walk; tap a speech marker to approach a colonist.
Tap OPERATIONS for missions and timely preparation choices.
Tap TITLE to leave safely; campaign changes autosave.
first_hour_tactical_lines: Tap a colonist, then a green tile, hostile, or visible action.
Forecasts show deterministic accuracy, cover, armour, and damage.
Tap HELP in battle for the full field manual; tap SAVE at any time.
tutorial.first_hour_skip_notice: Skipping hides teaching prompts but preserves every campaign goal.
tutorial.tactical_manual_paused: The battle is paused while this reference is open.
tactical_read_field_lines: Tap/click a colonist to make them active.
Green tiles are reachable this activation.
Drag to pan; use the mouse wheel to zoom.
Tap a hostile to inspect its forecast, then tap ATTACK to fire.
tactical_spend_phase_lines: Movement and weapons spend action points.
Class, mutation, gear, and overwatch add options.
End Phase warns once if colonists remain ready.
Orange intent lines forecast the first response.
tactical_survive_ground_lines: O Spore bloom: 1 damage and Hindered.
Each hostile faction ignores its own hazard.
tactical_win_contract_lines: Read the objective and live progress at right.
Gold rings mark objectives and extraction.
Some missions require interaction; others survival.
Save and load remain available during battle.
tutorial.tactical_touch_controls: TOUCH // TAP MAP TO INSPECT · DRAG MAP TO PAN · TAP +/- TO ZOOM · TAP NEXT READY / END PHASE / SAVE / LOAD / HELP / LOG
tutorial.tactical_optional_controls: OPTIONAL // KEYS ARROWS / TAB / ENTER / S / L / H / B · PAD D-PAD / A / B / X / Y / RB / START
